# Create the BDI Environment Setup Script for Termux

# ================================================= 
# BDI Agent Environment Setup for Termux
# Enterprise-Grade Jupyter Migration Implementation
# Target: >$50K/month Revenue with Zero-Cost Infrastructure
# =================================================

set -e  # Exit on error

echo "🚀 BDI Agent Environment Setup Starting..."
echo "🎯 Target: Enterprise-Grade Jupyter Migration"
echo "💰 Revenue Goal: >$50K/month with Zero-Cost Infrastructure"
echo "🤖 Philosophy: Android as Command Center, Cloud as Execution Plane"
echo ""

# Colors for output
RED='\\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\\033[0;34m'
NC='\\033[0m' # No Color

log_info() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

log_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[SUCCESS]${NC} $1"
}

log_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"
}

log_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# ================================================= 
# PHASE 1: TERMUX BASE SETUP
# =================================================
log_info "Phase 1: Setting up Termux base environment..."

# Update packages
pkg update -y && pkg upgrade -y

# Install essential packages
log_info "Installing essential Termux packages..."
pkg install -y python python-pip git wget curl openssh vim nano proot-distro x11-repo

# Install X11 and VNC components for GUI
log_info "Installing X11 and VNC components..."
pkg install -y tigervnc xfce4 firefox

# Create directories
mkdir -p ~/bdi-agent/{scripts,notebooks,config,logs,data}
mkdir -p ~/.vnc
mkdir -p ~/.jupyter

# ================================================= 
# PHASE 2: PROOT UBUNTU SETUP
# =================================================
log_info "Phase 2: Setting up PRoot Ubuntu for heavy dependencies..."

# Install Ubuntu 22.04 in PRoot
log_info "Installing Ubuntu 22.04 in PRoot..."
proot-distro install ubuntu

# Create Ubuntu setup script
cat > ~/bdi-agent/scripts/setup_ubuntu.sh << 'UBUNTU_EOF'

# Ubuntu environment setup for heavy dependencies

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Update Ubuntu
apt update && apt upgrade -y

# Install Python and development tools
apt install -y python3 python3-pip python3-dev python3-venv
apt install -y build-essential cmake git curl wget
apt install -y libffi-dev libssl-dev libblas-dev liblapack-dev
apt install -y pkg-config libhdf5-dev

# Install Jupyter and scientific computing
pip3 install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
pip3 install jupyter jupyterlab notebook
pip3 install numpy scipy matplotlib pandas seaborn plotly
pip3 install requests beautifulsoup4 lxml selenium

# Install Quantum Computing Libraries (Heavy Dependencies)
log_info "Installing PennyLane for quantum-inspired processing..."
pip3 install pennylane pennylane-lightning pennylane-qiskit
pip3 install qiskit qiskit-aer qiskit-ibm-runtime

# Install AI/ML Libraries
pip3 install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
pip3 install transformers accelerate datasets
pip3 install scikit-learn xgboost lightgbm
pip3 install openai anthropic langchain

# Install BDI-specific dependencies
pip3 install asyncio aiohttp websockets
pip3 install pydantic fastapi uvicorn
pip3 install redis celery
pip3 install sqlalchemy psycopg2-binary
pip3 install prometheus-client grafana-api

# Cloud SDK installations
pip3 install google-cloud-storage google-cloud-functions-framework
pip3 install boto3 azure-storage-blob
pip3 install supabase
pip3 install vercel

echo "Ubuntu environment setup completed!"
UBUNTU_EOF

chmod +x ~/bdi-agent/scripts/setup_ubuntu.sh

# Run Ubuntu setup
log_info "Configuring Ubuntu environment..."
proot-distro login ubuntu -- bash -c "$(cat ~/bdi-agent/scripts/setup_ubuntu.sh)"

log_success "PRoot Ubuntu setup completed!"

# ================================================= 
# PHASE 3: VNC SERVER CONFIGURATION
# =================================================
log_info "Phase 3: Configuring VNC server for GUI access..."

# Create VNC startup script
cat > ~/.vnc/xstartup << 'VNC_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
unset SESSION_MANAGER
unset DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS
exec startxfce4
VNC_EOF

chmod +x ~/.vnc/xstartup

# Set VNC password (default: bdiagent)
echo "bdiagent" | vncpasswd -f > ~/.vnc/passwd
chmod 600 ~/.vnc/passwd

# Create VNC service script
cat > ~/bdi-agent/scripts/start_vnc.sh << 'VNC_SERVICE_EOF'
#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash

# Start VNC server for BDI Agent GUI
export DISPLAY=:1
export PULSE_RUNTIME_PATH=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/var/run/pulse

# Kill existing VNC sessions
vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true

# Start VNC server
vncserver :1 -geometry 1280x720 -depth 24 -name "BDI Agent Command Center"

echo "🖥️  VNC Server started on display :1"
echo "📱 Connect using VNC Viewer to: localhost:5901"
echo "🔐 Password: bdiagent"
echo ""
echo "🚀 Starting Jupyter Lab in PRoot Ubuntu..."

# Start Jupyter in PRoot Ubuntu
proot-distro login ubuntu -- bash -c "
cd /root && 
export JUPYTER_CONFIG_DIR=/root/.jupyter &&
jupyter lab --ip=0.0.0.0 --port=8888 --no-browser --allow-root --ServerApp.token='' --ServerApp.password='' > /tmp/jupyter.log 2>&1 &
echo 'Jupyter Lab started on port 8888'
echo 'Access at: http://localhost:8888'
"

echo "🎯 BDI Agent Command Center is ready!"
echo "📊 Jupyter Lab: http://localhost:8888"
echo "🖥️  VNC Display: localhost:5901"
VNC_SERVICE_EOF

chmod +x ~/bdi-agent/scripts/start_vnc.sh

# ================================================= 
# PHASE 4: JUPYTER KERNELSPEC CONFIGURATION
# =================================================

# Create BDI kernel configuration

{
    "argv": [
        "/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/proot-distro",
        "login",
        "ubuntu",
        "--",
        "python3",
        "-m",
        "ipykernel_launcher",
        "-f",
        "{connection_file}"
    ],
    "display_name": "BDI Agent (PRoot Ubuntu)",
    "language": "python",
    "metadata": {
        "description": "BDI Agent with Quantum-Inspired Processing",
        "tags": ["quantum", "ai", "bdi", "enterprise"],
        "revenue_target": "$50K+/month"
    }
}
KERNEL_EOF

# Install kernelspec in Ubuntu
proot-distro login ubuntu -- bash -c "
jupyter kernelspec install /root/bdi-agent/config/kernels/bdi-proot --user --name=bdi-proot
"

log_success "BDI kernelspec installed!"

# ================================================= 
# PHASE 5: CLOUD INTEGRATION SETUP
# =================================================
log_info "Phase 5: Setting up cloud integrations for zero-cost infrastructure..."

# Create environment configuration
cat > ~/bdi-agent/config/cloud_config.env << 'CLOUD_EOF'
# ================================================= 
# BDI Agent Cloud Configuration
# Zero-Cost Infrastructure Setup
# =================================================

# Google Cloud Platform (Free Tier)
export GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT="bdi-agent-project"
export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS="/root/bdi-agent/config/gcp-service-account.json"

# AWS (Free Tier)
export AWS_REGION="us-east-1"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="your-aws-access-key"
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="your-aws-secret-key"

# Vercel (Free Tier)
export VERCEL_TOKEN="your-vercel-token"
export VERCEL_PROJECT_ID="bdi-agent-api"

# Supabase (Free Tier)
export SUPABASE_URL="https://your-project.supabase.co"
export SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="your-anon-key"
export SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY="your-service-role-key"

# OpenAI API
export OPENAI_API_KEY="your-openai-api-key"

# Anthropic Claude API
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="your-anthropic-api-key"

# Revenue Tracking
export STRIPE_SECRET_KEY="your-stripe-secret-key"
export STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY="your-stripe-publishable-key"

# Monitoring
export PROMETHEUS_GATEWAY="http://localhost:9091"
export GRAFANA_API_KEY="your-grafana-api-key"
CLOUD_EOF

# Create cloud services initialization script
cat > ~/bdi-agent/scripts/init_cloud_services.sh << 'CLOUD_INIT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Initialize cloud services for BDI Agent
source ~/bdi-agent/config/cloud_config.env

echo "🌐 Initializing cloud services..."

# Install cloud CLIs in Ubuntu
proot-distro login ubuntu -- bash -c "
# Google Cloud SDK
curl https://sdk.cloud.google.com | bash
source ~/.bashrc

# AWS CLI
pip3 install awscli

# Vercel CLI
npm install -g vercel

# Supabase CLI
npm install -g supabase

echo 'Cloud CLIs installed successfully!'
"

echo "✅ Cloud services initialized!"
echo "📝 Configure your API keys in ~/bdi-agent/config/cloud_config.env"
CLOUD_INIT_EOF

chmod +x ~/bdi-agent/scripts/init_cloud_services.sh

# ================================================= 
# PHASE 6: REVENUE TRACKING SETUP
# =================================================
log_info "Phase 6: Setting up revenue tracking and monitoring..."

# Create revenue tracking configuration
cat > ~/bdi-agent/config/revenue_config.json << 'REVENUE_EOF'
{
    "revenue_targets": {
        "monthly_target": 50000,
        "currency": "USD",
        "tracking_start_date": "2024-01-01"
    },
    "revenue_streams": {

            "target_percentage": 40,

        },

            "target_percentage": 25,
            "license_models": {
                "individual": 19,

                "enterprise": 149
            }
        }
    },
    "monitoring": {
        "metrics_endpoint": "http://localhost:9090/metrics",
        "dashboard_url": "http://localhost:3000",
        "alert_thresholds": {
            "daily_revenue_drop": 0.20,
            "conversion_rate_drop": 0.15,
            "system_uptime": 0.99
        }
    }
}
REVENUE_EOF

# ================================================= 
# PHASE 7: FINAL SETUP AND VERIFICATION
# =================================================
log_info "Phase 7: Final setup and verification..."

# Create startup script for the entire BDI environment
cat > ~/bdi-agent/start_bdi_environment.sh << 'STARTUP_EOF'
#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash

echo "🚀 Starting BDI Agent Environment..."
echo "💰 Revenue Target: >$50K/month"
echo "🎯 Philosophy: Android Command Center + Cloud Execution"
echo ""

# Load cloud configuration
source ~/bdi-agent/config/cloud_config.env

# Start VNC and Jupyter
~/bdi-agent/scripts/start_vnc.sh

echo ""
echo "🎉 BDI Agent Environment is READY!"
echo ""
echo "📊 Access Points:"
echo "   • Jupyter Lab: http://localhost:8888"
echo "   • VNC Display: localhost:5901 (password: bdiagent)" 
echo "   • Revenue Dashboard: http://localhost:3000 (after setup)"
echo ""
echo "🔧 Next Steps:"
echo "   1. Configure API keys in ~/bdi-agent/config/cloud_config.env"
echo "   2. Run ~/bdi-agent/scripts/init_cloud_services.sh"
echo "   3. Open Jupyter and load 01_belief_manager_development.ipynb"
echo ""
echo "💡 Quick Start: jupyter lab --ip=0.0.0.0 --port=8888 --no-browser"
STARTUP_EOF

chmod +x ~/bdi-agent/start_bdi_environment.sh

# Create helpful aliases
cat >> ~/.bashrc << 'ALIAS_EOF'

# BDI Agent Aliases
alias bdi-start='~/bdi-agent/start_bdi_environment.sh'
alias bdi-jupyter='proot-distro login ubuntu -- jupyter lab --ip=0.0.0.0 --port=8888 --no-browser --allow-root'
alias bdi-vnc='~/bdi-agent/scripts/start_vnc.sh'
alias bdi-logs='tail -f ~/bdi-agent/logs/*.log'
alias bdi-status='ps aux | grep -E "(jupyter|vnc|python)"'

ALIAS_EOF

source ~/.bashrc

# Final verification
log_info "Performing final verification..."

if proot-distro list | grep -q ubuntu; then
    log_success "✅ PRoot Ubuntu installed"
else
    log_error "❌ PRoot Ubuntu installation failed"
fi

if command -v vncserver > /dev/null; then
    log_success "✅ VNC Server available"
else
    log_error "❌ VNC Server not found"
fi

if proot-distro login ubuntu -- python3 -c "import jupyter" 2>/dev/null; then
    log_success "✅ Jupyter installed in Ubuntu"
else
    log_error "❌ Jupyter not found in Ubuntu"
fi

echo ""
echo "🎉 BDI AGENT ENVIRONMENT SETUP COMPLETED!"
echo ""
echo "📋 Summary:"
echo "   • Termux base environment: ✅ Ready"
echo "   • PRoot Ubuntu with heavy deps: ✅ Ready" 
echo "   • VNC server for GUI: ✅ Ready"
echo "   • Jupyter with BDI kernel: ✅ Ready"
echo "   • Cloud integration config: ✅ Ready"
echo "   • Revenue tracking setup: ✅ Ready"
echo ""
echo "🚀 START YOUR BDI AGENT:"
echo "   ./bdi-agent/start_bdi_environment.sh"
echo ""
echo "💰 TARGET: >$50K/MONTH WITH ZERO-COST INFRASTRUCTURE"
echo "🎯 NEXT: Load 01_belief_manager_development.ipynb"
'''

# Save the setup script
with open('/home/user/output/setup_bdi_environment.sh', 'w') as f:
    f.write(setup_script)

print("✅ Created setup_bdi_environment.sh")
print("📄 Location: /home/user/output/setup_bdi_environment.sh")
print("🎯 Features: Termux + PRoot Ubuntu + VNC + Jupyter + Cloud Integration")
